facts.text: Six Senses Shaharut nestles into a dramatic cliff in the Negev Desert.
facts.excerpt: It is on this boundless horizon that Six Senses Shaharut resort and spa in Israel nestles into a dramatic cliff

facts.text: The Arava Valley offers historic landmarks and a setting for extreme sports.
facts.excerpt: The Arava Valley offers historic landmarks and exciting setting for extreme sports.

facts.text: Experiences range from exploring ancient archaeological sites and natural wonders to outdoor sports.
facts.excerpt: you’ll find a wide array of experiences, from exploring ancient archaeological sites and natural wonders to outdoor sports

facts.text: Guests transfer to the resort through the desert landscape.
facts.excerpt: The journey to reach us is part of the story as you transfer through the dramatic desert landscape

facts.text: Suites and villas have uninterrupted desert panoramas and a private swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Suites and villas offer uninterrupted desert panoramas and are complete with a private swimming pool

facts.text: Suites offer a large outdoor space plus desert, valley and mountain views.
facts.excerpt: Suites offer a large outdoor space plus desert, valley and mountain views.

facts.text: A GEM (Guest Experience Maker) is on hand to arrange activities.
facts.excerpt: Your GEM (Guest Experience Maker) is on hand to make every activity (or inactivity) a reality.

facts.text: Six Senses Shaharut was the first hotel in Israel to achieve LEED Certification.
facts.excerpt: As the first hotel in Israel to achieve LEED Certification

facts.text: Food waste is composted, water is bottled on site and there is zero discharge of liquids into the environment.
facts.excerpt: Food waste is composted, water is bottled on site, and there is a zero discharge of liquids into the environment.

facts.text: Guests can visit the Earth Lab to learn about the resort's sustainability efforts.
facts.excerpt: Come visit our Earth Lab to learn more about our sustainability efforts

facts.text: The spa offers locally inspired treatments and integrated wellness therapies.
facts.excerpt: Locally-inspired treatments and integrated wellness therapies.

facts.text: The Nomadic Dinner is an intimate dinner for two, topped off with dessert in the desert.
facts.excerpt: Nomadic Dinner: intimate dinner for two, topped off with dessert in the desert.

facts.text: The resort welcomes guests and children 10 years and older.
facts.excerpt: A quiet desert haven welcoming guests and children 10 years and older.
